box.tools_locked: Tool mapping can be changed while the printer is idle

exclude.confirm_body: Are you sure you want to exclude this object from printing? The printer skips it for the rest of this print, and it can’t be added back.
exclude.title: Exclude objects
exclude.hint: Click an object on the bed or in the list to stop printing it. Green objects are still printing, amber is the one printing now, red ones are excluded.

toolhead.position_hint: Type a position and press Enter to move {{axis}} there
toolhead.position_unhomed: {{axis}} isn't homed. Home it to move by position.
toolhead.unhomed_on_title: Moving without homing: unhomed axes have no limits and the motors switch off after each move. Click to stop.
toolhead.unhomed_off_title: Move unhomed axes anyway, with no limits

toolhead.z_plus_capped: Z+ {{step}} mm: the bed moves down. Z steps stop at {{max}} mm.
toolhead.z_minus: Z− {{step}} mm: the bed moves up
toolhead.wait_last: Wait for the printer to finish the last command.
toolhead.unhomed_confirm_body: Unhomed axes will move with no limits, so the toolhead can hit the frame and the bed can hit the nozzle. After each move the motors switch off, so every axis needs homing again before printing.
toolhead.heat_to_extrude: Heat the nozzle to {{min}} °C to extrude
toolhead.closer_title: Lower the nozzle {{step}} mm toward the bed
toolhead.farther_title: Raise the nozzle {{step}} mm off the bed

temps.target_hint: Type a {{name}} target and press Enter. 0 turns it off.
